name: minimal-clock-macro
description: Minimal macro clock motion graphic (Remotion + WebGL2 shader), authored in 4K

scripts.render:v1: remotion render ClockMacro-V1 "out/Version 1 - Minimal Clock Macro (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v2: remotion render ClockMacro-V2 "out/Version 2 - Minimal Clock Macro - Midnight Gold (1080p).mp4" --scale=0.5
scripts.render:v1:4k: remotion render ClockMacro-V1 "out/Version 1 - Minimal Clock Macro (4K).mp4"
scripts.render:v2:4k: remotion render ClockMacro-V2 "out/Version 2 - Minimal Clock Macro - Midnight Gold (4K).mp4"
scripts.render: npm run render:v1 && npm run render:v2
